messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game from the user’s world and boss concept, or adapt an existing game.
- Include four artifact-collecting worlds, a final Citadel boss with three phases, and the secret ending line.

## Requirements
- Worlds: Abandoned City (find keys), Digital Nightmare (defeat glitches), Forgotten Desert (find an artifact), Cosmic Abyss (open a portal), Citadel ULTITANKIST_RUT (defeat the boss).
- Award one ancient artifact piece after each of the first four worlds; all four open the Citadel gate.
- Boss phases: Normal Form (energy attacks and teleportation), GLITCH FORM (space distortion and digital copies), ABSOLUTE FORM (red energy and arena destruction).
- Preserve the boss’s final line: “You've reached the very end... But you didn't think you could defeat ULTITANKIST_RUT, did you?”
- Preserve the secret ending: “ULTITANKIST_RUT hasn't finished his game yet...”
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Screenshot checks, if performed, should save small JPEGs at ≤1280px wide and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser canvas game with keyboard and touch controls; assumed a top-down arcade adventure format.
- Implemented each world’s objective with a gate or portal to advance.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` implementing the game UI, gameplay, five worlds, collectibles, HUD, enemy combat, phased boss, and endings.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Installed Playwright Chromium after browser launch initially failed because it was not installed.

### Active
- Browser verification and any resulting gameplay/UI fixes remain to be done.

### Blocked
- Initial screenshot attempt was blocked by the missing Playwright Chromium executable; Chromium has since been installed, so this is no longer blocked.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli` and inspect the game in-browser.
2. Check browser console/runtime errors, test start and movement/attack controls, and save/read only the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Fix any found issues; then report the implementation and verification status.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game shell, HUD, start/pause/end screens, and touch controls.
- `styles.css`: responsive layout and game visual styling.
- `game.js`: canvas drawing, gameplay systems, world progression, and boss phases.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The user explicitly supplied the boss quote, which is currently shown as the Citadel-entry toast.
- Secret ending text is included in the victory screen.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game from the user’s world and boss concept, or adapt an existing game.
- Include four artifact-collecting worlds, a three-phase Citadel boss, and the secret ending line.

## Requirements
- Worlds: Abandoned City (find keys), Digital Nightmare (defeat glitches), Forgotten Desert (find an artifact), Cosmic Abyss (open a portal), and Citadel ULTITANKIST_RUT (defeat the boss).
- Award one ancient artifact piece after each of the first four worlds; all four open the Citadel gate.
- Boss phases: Normal Form (energy attacks and teleportation), GLITCH FORM (space distortion and digital copies), ABSOLUTE FORM (red energy and arena destruction).
- Preserve the boss’s final line: “You've reached the very end... But you didn't think you could defeat ULTITANKIST_RUT, did you?”
- Preserve the secret ending: “ULTITANKIST_RUT hasn't finished his game yet...”
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- If taking screenshots, save small JPEGs at ≤1280px wide and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser canvas game with keyboard and touch controls; assumed a top-down arcade adventure format.
- Implemented each world’s objective with a gate or portal to advance.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` with the game UI, gameplay, five worlds, collectibles, HUD, enemy combat, phased boss, and endings.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the final round of code edits.
- Started a local server at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Opened the game in Playwright, started a run, and verified the HUD showed Abandoned City with three keys remaining.
- Saved and read `screenshots/latest.jpg` (JPEG screenshot).
- No gameplay/runtime console errors were observed; only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404.

### Active
- Recheck syntax after the latest edits and continue in-browser gameplay/control checks; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` after the latest edits.
2. Continue browser checks for movement, attack, pause, and world progression; inspect console errors.
3. Fix any issues and report implementation and verification status.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game shell, HUD, start/pause/end screens, and touch controls.
- `styles.css`: responsive layout and game styling.
- `game.js`: canvas drawing, gameplay systems, world progression, boss phases, and endings.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: most recent small JPEG gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Boss quote appears in the Citadel-entry toast; secret ending appears in the victory screen.
